pages.text: A $(l)Resonance Core$(/l) floods power through connected $(l)Lumen Conduits$(/l) (dead → dim → active) and opens the $(l)Ancient Doors$(/l) they reach. $(l)Lumen Relays$(/l) bridge gaps in the network.

A powered $(l)Gravity Lens$(/l) lifts entities in the column above it. A dead city's $(l)Dormant Light Engine$(/l) can be restored with a looted $(o)resonance core fragment$() — waking the network. Cores and lenses can be rebuilt from looted fragments.
